contracts.claim: Video metadata binds exact source bytes and model-facing stream/audio dimensions to real FFprobe observations.

Every completed video digest returns counts matching its durable manifest, hash-bound timestamped frames and a matching storyboard; real scene duplicate suppression and extracted audio are checked at startup.
Video-analysis action proposals select video.digest with the exact recognized source path.
Resident UI semantic identity ignores focus/hover presentation noise while preserving durable node identity, role, value, actions and quantized bounds.
Every resident graph replacement stamps all nodes with its new revision and binds returned changes to the exact current semantic hash and node set.
Semantic graph diffs return each actual added/changed/removed identity exactly once.
UI graph search returns sorted bounded nodes matching exact/substring role/name/id queries or free text; it never returns a nonmatching control.
Compact UI deltas retain graph revision/hash and every bounded changed identity without returning a full tree.
Playwright/CDP AX payload normalization preserves stable actionable role/source identity and editable values, omits presentation noise and exposes no disabled click action.
Every compact UI result explicitly omits trees and binds its revision, semantic hash and node count to the resident graph.
Stale revision/hash UI actions reject before graph mutation; startup proves actual no-page failure without fabricating a browser interaction.
Native/progressive UI registration installs every compact tool once with callable/describable handlers; progressive search omits full schemas and describe supplies them.
